_note: Pinned USDA FoodData Central bulk files for the local import (migrations 055 + 056). `npx tsx scripts/import-usda.ts fetch` downloads them into the gitignored .cache/usda/ and refuses any file whose SHA-256 or size differs; every later command re-hashes them. Raw files are never committed. FoodData Central data is in the public domain (CC0 1.0); cite: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service. FoodData Central, fdc.nal.usda.gov.

foundation.why: The October 2026 Foundation CSV zip has no food, nutrient or portion tables, so the JSON release is used (spec (f)).

fndds.why: FNDDS 2021-2023. Its food_nutrient.csv keys nutrients by the OLD numbers (208 energy, 203 protein, 204 fat, 205 carbohydrate, 291 fibre), not the 1008/1003/1004/1005/1079 ids SR uses.
